bubbles.ocrText: ...THOUGH THIS BANTER WAS A WHOLE LOT BETTER IN MY HEAD.
bubbles.speaker: tessik
bubbles.textWithCues: [sarcastic] [exhales] ...Though this banter was a whole lot better in my head.

bubbles.ocrText: YOU FLEET-FOOTED TORTOISES ARE MY IMMORTAL FOES.
bubbles.speaker: hopscald
bubbles.voiceDescription: Deep, raspy, monstrous male voice with a dramatic, aggressive tone
bubbles.textWithCues: [angry] YOU FLEET-FOOTED TORTOISES ARE MY IMMORTAL FOES.

bubbles.ocrText: WARBUNNY WILL SILENCE THE CRITIQUES ONCE AND FOR ALL.
bubbles.speaker: hopscald
bubbles.voiceDescription: Deep, gravelly, monstrous male voice, melodramatic and threatening
bubbles.textWithCues: [growling] Warbunny WILL SILENCE the critiques once and for ALL.

bubbles.ocrText: BRING THE SWING, BUNNY BOY!
bubbles.speaker: fenwick

bubbles.ocrText: THE GOOD NEWS IS, A RABBIT'S TEETH NEVER STOP GROWING, SO WE DON'T HAVE TO FEEL BAD ABOUT KNOCKING ANY OUT.
bubbles.speaker: tessik
bubbles.textWithCues: [Matter-of-factly] The good news is, a rabbit's teeth never stop growing, [smirks] so we don't have to feel bad about knocking any out.

bubbles.ocrText: YOU'RE WORSE THAN BILLY.
bubbles.speaker: amber-vole

bubbles.ocrText: ALPHA, THIS IS TRINI. DO YOU COPY?
bubbles.speaker: amber-vole
bubbles.textWithCues: [professional] Alpha, this is Trini. Do you copy?

bubbles.ocrText: AYE-YI-YI! ROGER THAT, TRINI.
bubbles.speaker: gizmo-9
bubbles.voiceDescription: High-pitched, neurotic, robotic voice with an electronic filter

bubbles.ocrText: ARE YOU ALRIGHT?
bubbles.speaker: gizmo-9

bubbles.ocrText: WE'RE NEARLY DONE FIGHTING ONE OF ZEDD'S MOST ADORABLE MONSTERS.
bubbles.speaker: amber-vole
bubbles.textWithCues: [sarcastic] We're nearly done fighting one of Zedd's most ADORABLE monsters.

bubbles.ocrText: ONCE THAT'S DONE, PARIS SHOULD BE ALL SAFE AND SOUND AGAIN.
bubbles.speaker: amber-vole
bubbles.textWithCues: [optimistic] Once that's done, Paris should be all safe and sound again.

bubbles.ocrText: DUDES, DOESN'T THIS KINDA FEEL LIKE ONE OF THOSE CRAZY AWESOME VINTAGE SIDE SCROLLER VIDEO GAMES?
bubbles.speaker: pollux
bubbles.voiceDescription: Young male, high-energy, 'surfer dude' accent, American, playful
bubbles.textWithCues: [excited] [strong surfer accent] DUDES, doesn't this kinda feel like one of those CRAZY AWESOME vintage side scroller video games?

bubbles.ocrText: NORTH DAKOTA.
bubbles.speaker: narrator

bubbles.ocrText: WE GOTTA WORK ON YOUR DEFINITION OF "AWESOME," MICHELANGELO.
bubbles.speaker: crimson-vole
bubbles.textWithCues: [Exasperated] We gotta work on your definition of [sarcastically] "awesome," Michelangelo.

bubbles.ocrText: EXACTLY!
bubbles.speaker: pollux

bubbles.ocrText: WE LIVE FOR THE FOOT. WE DIE FOR THE FOOT.
bubbles.speaker: drab-grunt
bubbles.voiceDescription: Muffled, raspy male voice, zealous and robotic tone
bubbles.textWithCues: [chanting] WE LIVE FOR THE FOOT. WE DIE FOR THE FOOT.

bubbles.ocrText: LET THE FIRE OF OUR CAUSE...
bubbles.speaker: drab-captain
bubbles.voiceDescription: Fanatical, ominous male voice, sounding like a disciplined ninja cultist
bubbles.textWithCues: [Chanting with intense, fanatical fervor] Let the fire of our cause...

bubbles.ocrText: ...ENGULF ALL THOSE WHO STAND AGAINST IT!
bubbles.speaker: drab-captain
bubbles.voiceDescription: Fanatical, raspy male voice, intense and aggressive
bubbles.textWithCues: [fanatical shouting] ...ENGULF ALL THOSE WHO STAND AGAINST IT!

bubbles.ocrText: Wait, they can throw fireballs now?
bubbles.speaker: rose-vole
bubbles.voiceDescription: Teen male voice, energetic, American accent
bubbles.textWithCues: [surprised] Wait, they can throw fireballs now?

bubbles.ocrText: Among other things.
bubbles.speaker: moss-vole

bubbles.ocrText: I wanna throw fireballs.
bubbles.speaker: rose-vole

voiceDescriptions.gizmo-9: A high-pitched, robotic voice with a distinct electronic filter, conveying a neurotic and anxious personality.
voiceDescriptions.fenwick: A teenage male voice with an intelligent, articulate American accent. It's confident and often sarcastic, carrying a relaxed yet inquisitive tone with a subtle tech-nerd inflection.
voiceDescriptions.drab-captain: A deep, disciplined, and authoritative male voice that is calm yet menacing. It is articulate and resonant, conveying a fanatical conviction, with a slight muffled quality from a mask that does not hinder its clear projection.
voiceDescriptions.drab-grunt: A fanatical, raspy male voice, gruff and often muffled by a mask, with an American accent. It conveys an intense, zealous aggression, characteristic of a disciplined ninja cultist or professional henchman, occasionally sounding breathless.
voiceDescriptions.moss-vole: A confident, heroic young adult male voice with an American accent. It possesses a strong, disciplined tone, capable of conveying both youthful energy and sincere determination, with a slight underlying rough edge.
voiceDescriptions.pollux: A young, high-energy American male voice with a distinct surfer dude accent. The tone is typically playful and enthusiastic, ready for action or a good time.
voiceDescriptions.narrator: A deep, resonant, and wise male voice with a philosophical storytelling tone. It's serious, authoritative, and cinematic, delivering narration with both epic gravitas and professional clarity.
voiceDescriptions.rose-vole: A youthful American female voice, energetic and distinctly sassy. It projects confidence and a heroic spirit, suitable for a dynamic and courageous character.
voiceDescriptions.tessik: A gruff, gritty young male voice with a deep tone. It features a thick, street-smart Brooklyn/New York accent, embodying a tough and rebellious character.
voiceDescriptions.crimson-vole: A heroic and confident young adult male voice with a distinct American accent. It carries a natural leadership tone but is versatile enough to convey a range of emotions from casualness to intense desperation.
voiceDescriptions.hopscald: A deep, booming, gravelly, and guttural male voice, monstrous and brutish. It projects an aggressively arrogant, theatrical barbarian warlord persona, capable of also sounding primitive and submissive.
